name: Moravian Church Settlements
countries: Denmark, United States of America, United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, Germany
description: Four small towns in Denmark, Germany, Northern Ireland and Pennsylvania were laid out in the 1700s by the Moravian Church as planned communities. Christiansfeld, Herrnhut, Gracehill and Bethlehem share a tidy design of Baroque-style buildings: a central church, large "choir houses" for single members, and a peaceful God's Acre cemetery nearby. Active congregations still keep the traditions alive.
